thread:
tina: HelioWorks (HW-314) flagged a charge on INV-2026-06-30. Their trial promo 'trial-50-hours' didn't apply for signup day so they were charged 45 trial hours = $90. Can finance review for a retro credit?

marta: Can you paste the invoice line and the expected credit?

tina: INV-2026-06-30 line: trial_hours_billed: 45 hrs @ $2 = $90. They expected first 50 hours free (trial-50-hours) -> full $90 credit.

brian: Quick trace shows onboarding webhook failed to set the trial flag for accounts created during a brief DB write stall on 2026-06-01 23:59 UTC. Log: ```2026-06-01T23:59:12Z ERROR onboarding-webhook: failed to upsert customer.flags hw-314 request_id=trx-77 cause=db-timeout```

billing-bot: Ticket created FIN-5101 to track HelioWorks trial-miss credit request (linked INV-2026-06-30).

marta: Policy: system-caused trial misses = retro credit. For small customers we usually issue credit memo to account balance; refunds allowed if customer insists. Recommend credit memo for $90. Any goodwill?

tina: HelioWorks is a new customer; offer $10 goodwill to smooth first-month experience. Total $100 if approved.

zach: I can approve up to $250 for onboarding issues. Ledger note needed for GL.

marta: Ledger note: "Trial flag missed due to onboarding webhook DB timeout; issued retro trial credit $90 + goodwill $10 to HelioWorks. Approved by finance lead zach." GL: SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026.

zach: Approved. Issue credit memo and apply to invoice; do account credit rather than cash refund.

marta: Creating credit memo CM-2026-115 for $100, attaching FIN-5101 and applying to INV-2026-06-30. Posting under GL SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026.

billing-bot: CM-2026-115 created and applied to INV-2026-06-30. Invoice balance adjusted; credit posted to account.

brian: I'll add a retry and idempotency guard to the onboarding webhook and add a nightly audit query to FIN-5101 to catch any other accounts missing trial flags. Opening PR and linking to FIN-5101.

marta: Please include the audit SQL snippet and runbook steps in the ticket for auditors.

tina: Customer notified; they confirmed the credit and appreciated the quick turnaround.

zach: Mark FIN-5101 resolved once PR + runbook attached. Good work.

marta: FIN-5101 moved to resolved; CM-2026-115 attached; invoice notes updated. Closing loop.

tina: Thanks team :white_check_mark:
